title: 1. Start
summary: Discover CoRE Stack datasets, make your first API request and save data to explore in a map or spreadsheet.

title: 2. Know Your Micro-Watershed
summary: Read a micro-watershed’s area, elevation, terrain, drainage and upstream and downstream connections.

title: 3. See Water through the Years and Seasons
summary: Compare annual and seasonal water values, fortnightly vegetation and water, and groundwater context.

title: 4. Analyse Water Storage: Surface Waterbodies
summary: Inspect individual waterbodies, seasonal water extent and the tehsil’s total mapped water area.

title: 5. Analyse Agriculture through Time
summary: Compare cropping patterns, their shares of recorded cropped area, and broader land cover through the years.

title: 6. Know Your Village
summary: Explore population, distances to services, livestock and village survey answers, and find linked micro-watersheds.
